High quality fine granular and chipped-rock detail, crisp but moderate contrast, suitable for walkable natural ground seen from an isometric strategy camera. Constant physical scale, rock features similar in size to the reference. Highest available native resolution. Perfectly tileable edges on both axes. Preserve the subdued warm volcanic red-brown level direction rather than saturated red paint. Full-frame tile only.
